hero.title:
Document

hero.subtitle: Detect every change between document versions and identify what needs to be updated in your knowledge base

sections.subtitle: The Problem
sections.title:
Documents evolve.
Knowledge bases don't.
statements: Every time a document is revised, dozens of related files in your knowledge base may become outdated.
Finding which ones manually takes days — and errors slip through.

sections.subtitle: The Features
sections.title: What the app does
sections.description: A complete workflow from document upload to knowledge base update — powered by Databricks and Claude AI

cards.title: PDF Diff Analysis
cards.description: Upload two PDF versions and get a structured markdown summary of every change — additions, removals, and modifications

cards.title: Impact Assessment
cards.description: Search the document index to identify which documents need updating and why

cards.title: Volume Storage
cards.description: PDFs and analysis reports are automatically saved to a Unity Catalog Volume with a timestamped folder

cards.title: Downloadable
cards.description: Download the change analysis or impact report as a PDF directly from the app

cards.title: 1. Upload
cards.description: Drop the old and new version of any PDF document

cards.title: 2. Analyse
cards.description: Get a full diff analysis streamed in real time by Claude AI

cards.title: 3. Act
cards.description: Identify impacted documents and save everything to your UC Volume
